description:
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Increasing Ambition, Time Walk, and any number of cards with different mana costs to your hand and putting Seasons Past on the bottom of your library.
Cast Increasing Ambition by paying {3}{B}{B}, putting Seasons Past from your library into your hand.
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, granting you an extra turn.
Repeat each turn.
